summary.name: LLMStack
summary.one_liner: A no-code platform for building generative AI apps, chatbots and agents that work with your own data.
use_cases: Build a chatbot over your own documents
Chain multiple LLM providers in one app
Create a generative AI app without coding
Ingest website sitemaps into an LLM app
Share AI apps with a team using role-based access
summary.what_it_does: LLMStack lets users chain models from major providers such as OpenAI, Cohere, Stability AI and Hugging Face to build generative AI apps. It can import your own data from web URLs, sitemaps, PDFs, audio, PPTs, Google Drive and Notion and connect that data to LLM models for chatbots and apps. Apps can be shared publicly or restricted to specific individuals using a permission model with viewer and collaborator roles. The page describes it as a no-code way to build apps and agents.
notable: Model chaining across providers like OpenAI, Cohere, Stability AI and Hugging Face
Data import from URLs, sitemaps, PDFs, audio, PPTs, Google Drive and Notion
Granular sharing with viewer and collaborator roles
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
